parameters.query: SELECT id, owner_id, metal_type, metal_weight_grams, wastage_percent, making_charge_type, making_charge_value, stone_value_inr, diamond_value_inr, hallmark_charge FROM products WHERE dynamic_price = true AND is_current = true AND metal_type IS NOT NULL AND metal_weight_grams IS NOT NULL AND metal_weight_grams > 0
SELECT owner_id, metal_type, rate_per_gram, purity_factor FROM metal_rates WHERE is_current = true
UPDATE products SET price = {{ $json.newPrice }}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'

INSERT INTO whatsapp_logs (owner_id, feature, customer_message, data_source) VALUES ('{{ $json.owner_id }}', 'dynamic_price_update', 'Auto-updated price to ₹{{ $json.newPrice }} (metal_cost=₹{{ $json.metalCost }}, rate=₹{{ $json.rate }}/g)', 'n8n_scheduler') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

meta.description: Runs at 12:40 PM and 6:40 PM IST daily. For every product with dynamic_price=true, fetches the owner's current metal rate from metal_rates, calculates the new price (metal cost + making + stones + hallmark, no GST), and updates products.price. If the exact purity rate is missing, it derives from the 999-base rate.
